title: The Macmillan Book of Social Science Quotations - David L Sills Robert K Merton
descriptionText: The product is "The Macmillan Book of Social Science Quotations" by David L. Sills and Robert K. Merton. Published by Macmillan Company, it is a hardcover book in English with illustrations. It has 437 pages and covers a variety of social science topics through quotations. The book is 9.9 inches long, 7 inches wide, and 1.3 inches high, weighing 18 ounces. It was published in 1992.
